address: Rua Barão da Torre 348, Rio de Janeiro, 22411-000, Brazil
bio: Located opposite the Praça Nossa Senhora da Paz, where the large windows at the entrance will definitely attract your attention thanks to the list of restaurants across Italy from which this trattoria takes its inspiration (such as the Enoteca Pinchiorri and Massimo Bottura’s Osteria Francescana). The enticing cuisine here is at times high on tradition with plentiful portions. On the impressive menu you’ll find standout dishes such as the mouthwatering fettuccine with a truffle and mushroom sauce and free-range egg, and the unmissable Wagyu polpetone filled with mozzarella di bufala and served with taglione in sage butter. Photos of famous jazz musicians and soft music in the background combine to provide a harmonious backdrop....
